interpretation: Retrospective post-freeze descriptive sensitivity analysis; not preregistration of the original study and not model reselection.
primary_sample: For each endpoint, same compounds with finite labels and finite scores from all three models, joined by inchikey_2d only. Cohorts are disjoint; confirm no repeated compound within an endpoint/model.
label_policy: Use final_external y_true as canonical label; require cross-model labels within absolute tolerance 1e-5; do not match on floating labels.
score_policy: All available frozen compound-level predictions before rejection. Preserve existing deployed probability calibration. raw_available means before abstention, not uncalibrated. Do not change thresholds, predictions or calibration.

metrics.P_screen_not_ready_binary: average_precision_score (AP), historically labeled pr_auc in code; no trapezoidal PR integration
metrics.regression: MAE in existing log10 target units

comparisons: Frozen final model vs Original six-field metadata
Frozen final model vs Matched nonfragment HGB
positive_gain: AP(final) - AP(control) for classification; MAE(control) - MAE(final) for regression

bootstrap.generator: numpy.random.default_rng(42), reinitialized for each cohort/endpoint; same sampled row indices for all models and both contrasts
bootstrap.CI: 2.5th and 97.5th percentile of valid replicates, pointwise descriptive 95% interval
bootstrap.single_class: skip one-class resamples for AP and report valid count

inference: No new p-values, significance labels or multiplicity-adjusted claims. Pointwise intervals do not account for model selection or dataset construction.
